messages:
jane_ae: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC hitting ~1.2s TTFT on short prompts (expect ~150-250ms). They also see intermittent 429s when bursts exceed ~800 req/min. POC review call Wed — need quick triage. Logs: https://paste.example.com/acme-poc-logs (contains per-request timings + X-Redwood-Route). cc @evan_se @tim_sre @maria_ml

evan_se: Can you paste a sample request + model name, avg prompt length, and concurrency? Also is this Hosted or Dedicated?

ejan_ae: Hosted (us-east-1), model: open-llama-13b, avg prompt ~60 tokens + ~300 token context, steady concurrency ~50 clients, default batching (we didn't change). Sample curl in logs.

maria_ml: Two quick suspects: (1) KV/prefix cache not warming because requests are hitting different conversation keys, (2) batching causing head-of-line delays if many short requests are pooled with long-context ones.

maria_ml: Try a controlled warmup: send 5 prefix-only warmup calls per shard before the heap of real traffic. Also check convo key usage — if each client uses unique key, caching won't help.

evan_se: Also share actual batch stats from the runtime (avg batch_size, queue_wait_ms). If queue_wait_ms >> token_generation_ms then batching is hurting TTFT.

tim_sre: FYI we had a transient autoscaler oscillation in us-east-1 last night (~03:12 UTC) that caused a small hot-shard for a 7-minute window. Might correlate with the 429s. I can check node-level metrics if you want.

tim_sre: The 429s look like API-gateway per-customer throttles (not model-level). I temporarily bumped Acme's quota to 2k/min while we triage. Recommend: (a) reduce client burst by smoothing in front-end, (b) request quota bump for POC via sales console, or (c) move critical traffic to Dedicated for predictable throughput.

ejan_ae: Thanks — Acme asked about pricing for bursts vs reserved capacity. They want cost estimate for a 24h spike (peak 5k/min for 30m).

carol_devex: Quick pricing note: Hosted has ephemeral burst credits; sustained high peaks are cheaper under Reserved (Dedicated) with burst buffer. I can send a simple cost calc after we know avg tokens/resp.

alex_security: Also flag: Acme is requesting answers to the security questionnaire (SAML, KMS, retention, audit logs). I can fill the security section if someone confirms whether logs in the paste are sanitized and where they persist (hosted logs retention policy?).

ejan_ae: Logs are sanitized (no PII), stored in our hosted logs for 30 days. Customer requires SOC2 + customer-managed KMS note.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: "Routing hotfix to us-east ded pool completed at 2026-03-21T08:14:02Z" :rocket:

tim_sre: I routed Acme to a temporary dedicated pool and enabled prefix_kv for their account; also lowered max_batch_size to 4 for their route to reduce queueing. Can you re-run the client test?

jane_ae: Re-ran tests at 08:20 — TTFT median dropped to ~320ms, p95 ~620ms. Still see 429s when frontend spikes >1k/min.

evan_se: Good improvement. For the remaining 429s: confirm whether they're from API-gateway or model-service. If API-gateway, smoothing + quota bump helps. If model-service, we'll look at per-shard connection caps. Share `X-Redwood-Route` header for an example 429.

jane_ae: Example header from 429 request: `X-Redwood-Route: us-east-1-ded-03`, response body: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":15}`.

tim_sre: That's API-gateway layer. I've opened a support ticket to raise temporary soft-limit for the account during POC window. Ticket #SUP-8342.

maria_ml: For long-term perf, recommend: (1) conversation-key consolidation, (2) explicit prefix warmup at deploy, (3) tune batch size per workload (we saw 4 for this load), (4) consider quantized variant for lower token latency if acceptable quality tradeoff.

carol_devex: I'll draft the pricing note + POC runbook (warmup script + client smoothing example + cost calc) and drop in the customer docs link.

alex_security: I'll start the security questionnaire draft. Need confirmation on: (a) are they ok with hosted logs retained 30 days? (b) do they require CMK (customer-managed key) for at-rest encryption? Reply yes/no.

jane_ae: They want CMK and 90-day logs retention. Can we update retention and enable CMK for the POC?

tim_sre: CMK enablement requires a short config change and review; I can enable for the POC but need Jira approval (I'll ping infra). For retention, we can extend to 90 days for this account.

jane_ae: Awesome — summary + next steps: 1) Tim: temporary quota bump + CMK enable + extend retention (SUP-8342, infra ticket created) 2) Evan/Maria: finalize warmup script and recommended batch config, post runbook (E2E test) 3) Carol: pricing calc for 24h spike and Dedicated delta 4) Alex: security questionnaire draft. I'll coordinate call Wed 10:00am ET and send calendar invite.

carol_devex: Noted — will have cost numbers in ~2 hours.

evans_se: Will post warmup curl + node-level metrics in the thread after testing.

maria_ml: Small script for warmup (example):
```
for i in 1..5 do
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"open-llama-13b","prompt":"warmup","prefill":true}'
done
```

jane_ae: Thanks all — progress looks solid. Will update customer and send invite. :thumbsup:

carol_devex: Cost calc attached in DM, short preview: Hosted burst -> ~$0.35/min extra during spike; Dedicated 1-week reserved buffer estimate reduces marginal cost by ~60% for that spike.

jane_ae: Copy. Closing the loop after Wed call.
